ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   B. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   D. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   B. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   C. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Arabic alphabet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Dua before and after waking up. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
